articles.title: Batwara 1947 Opens to Modest ₹3.67 Crore on Day 1, Trails Awarapan 2
articles.excerpt: Sunny Deol's Partition drama, produced by Aamir Khan and directed by Rajkumar Santoshi, faces stiff competition from Emraan Hashmi's action sequel on a crowded Independence Day weekend.
articles.image_caption: Sunny Deol in Batwara 1947, a Partition drama directed by Rajkumar Santoshi and produced by Aamir Khan Productions. The film released on August 14, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Based on the celebrated Urdu play Jis Lahore Nai Vekhya, Batwara 1947 explores the human cost of the 1947 Partition — a defining event for the Indian diaspora whose families carry multigenerational memories of displacement.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sonu Nigam Admits He Uses Auto-Tune in Some Songs, Blames Digitised Recording
articles.excerpt: The veteran singer, long considered one of the few Bollywood vocalists who never needed pitch correction, said digital recording environments make a raw voice sound off without some processing.
articles.nri_angle: Sonu Nigam is among the most recognizable voices for the Indian diaspora, whose songs define nostalgia for NRIs worldwide; his candid take on auto-tune reshapes perceptions of a singer who has been a cultural constant across three decades.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Awarapan 2 Opens to ₹12.86 Crore on Day 1 After Selling 2.85 Lakh Advance Tickets
articles.excerpt: Emraan Hashmi's sequel to the 2007 cult classic recorded the third-highest pre-sales of 2026, outpacing Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 by a wide margin on Independence Day weekend.
articles.nri_angle: The sequel to a cult classic from the mid-2000s that holds deep nostalgia for Indian diaspora audiences who grew up with Emraan Hashmi's romantic thrillers and the iconic 'Toh Phir Aao' soundtrack.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Batwara 1947 to Main Vaapas Aaunga: Bollywood Retells Partition With New Sensitivity
articles.excerpt: As India marks Independence Day, two major 2026 films explore Partition through personal stories of love, loss, and displacement rather than political spectacle.
articles.image_caption: Sunny Deol stars in Batwara 1947, a Partition drama directed by Rajkumar Santoshi and produced by Aamir Khan, releasing on August 14.
articles.nri_angle: Partition is foundational to the Indian diaspora experience, and these films offer the diaspora a cultural bridge to engage with family histories of displacement and migration.

articles.title: Rajkummar Rao's Prahaar Gets New October 16 Release After Multiple Delays
articles.excerpt: The Ujjwal Nikam biopic, originally set for August 7, has been pushed to October 16 to avoid box office clashes with Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2.
articles.nri_angle: The 26/11 Mumbai attacks deeply impacted the global Indian community; a film centring on prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam's trial of Ajmal Kasab is expected to resonate with NRI audiences worldwide.

articles.title: Sushant Singh Rajput's Sister Shweta Reveals Actor Was Deeply Disturbed After Disha Salian's Death

articles.title: Suriya's 'Vishwanath And Sons' Clocks Rs 200 Crore Pre-Release Business
articles.excerpt: Tamil superstar Suriya's upcoming family drama has secured over Rs 215 crore in pre-release business across theatrical and non-theatrical avenues, with the film set for a worldwide release on August 14.
